annotations.title: Where to live or travel: astrocartography lines

description: WHERE questions: which city or country suits the person for career, love, home, money or health, or what a move abroad would bring. Draws where each graha was rising (ASC), setting (DSC), overhead (MC) or underfoot (IC) at birth; the lines do not depend on the ayanamsa. Checks up to 20 named places (east-west distance in km, strong within 300 km, moderate within 700, mild within 1,100) and ranks them for the goal; with no places it ranks the curated world cities and Indian metros. Deterministic; a tendency, not a guarantee.

includeLines.description: Also return every line (MC/IC longitudes, ASC/DSC sampled every 5 degrees of latitude)
